image_description: A close-up view of a grey whale's head and upper body emerging vertically from the water next to a blue boat hull. The whale displays characteristic mottled grey skin with white barnacle patches. The rostrum is arched, and blowholes are visible on top. No dorsal fin is present, consistent with the species. The background shows calm ocean water.
